records.subject: product_definition
records.value: AI-generated background music for small cafés, restaurants, salons and gyms; staff uses only calm/lively controls; billing is metered by audible output.

records.subject: catalog_and_engine
records.value: 800 tracks across 20 weighted channels; fixed autoDial → hoodDelta → clamp → staff override → clamp order; outside-hours stage 1.

records.subject: public_runtime
records.value: Cloudflare Worker maejang-sori-preview serves 117 static files at freestoremusic.scanners.cc; no executable bindings; backend/payment are not connected.

records.subject: local_verification
records.value: npm test: 35 test files passed; engine exhaustive 60,480 cases; this does not prove audio, R2, Google login, PG or physical-device behavior.

records.subject: known_blockers
records.value: Google origin approval/secret, PostgreSQL endpoint, PG live test, real Google login, real Android device and live audio remain unverified.

unknowns: ACE-Step measured candidates are excluded from this run per current user instruction; no live audio was available.
